                           ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all the B3-1 Community Shopping

District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.13-S in the area bounded by


       A line 165.10 feet north of and parallel to West Foster Avenue;
       a line 167 feet east of and parallel to North Rose Street; a line
       82.55 feet north of and parallel to West Foster Avenue; and
       North Rose Sti'eet,


to those of a C2-1 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.




Common address of property;          5207 North Rose Street

9.    Present Zoning District: B3-1           Proposed Zoning District: C2-1

10.   Lot size in square feet (or dimensions): 13.786 sq. ft.

11.   Current Use of the Property: The subject propertv is improved with a two-storv
      warehouse and office building.

12.   Reason for rezoning the property: The Applicants are seeking a zoning map amendment to
      permit the indoor and outdoor storage of vehicles at the subject propertv.

13.   Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of
      dwelling unit number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial
      space; and height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC): The Applicants are seeking
      a zoning map amendment to permit the indoor and outdoor storage of vehicles at the subject
      propertv. The first floor warehouse Capproximatelv 8.917 so. ft.^ and second floor office
      uses will remain. The existing 29.3 ft. building height dimension and floor area total will
      remain without change. The existing building's first floor can accommodate eight (8^
      indoor parking spaces (in addition to the existing warehouse spaceT Four (4") outdoor
      parking spaces will be located on the west side of the subject lot.

14.   The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARC) requires on-site affordable housing units
      and/or a financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that
      receive a zoning change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area,
      or, for existing Planned Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact
      sheet or visit www.cityofchicago.org/ARC for more information). Is this project subject to
      the ARO?

      YES             NO     X
